name: siri-ai
description: Siri.ai — ADHD-focused task orchestrator (Python FastAPI backend + React client)

scripts.ensure:py: cd server-py && (test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && (test -f .venv/bin/uvicorn || .venv/bin/pip install --quiet -r requirements.txt)
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm run ensure:py
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:server: npm run ensure:py && cd server-py && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 4000
scripts.start: npm run ensure:py && cd server-py && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 4000
scripts.test: npm run ensure:py && cd server-py && .venv/bin/python -m pytest
